candidate_formula: Sum the same 19 current contributions except index 8, plus unchanged trend. Do not redistribute weights or recalculate other features. Name-ascending tie break identical to parent.
selection_reason: Development-only no-context arm had 438/744 correctly ordered actual-top-four pairs versus 435/744 and mean rank error 1.941532 versus 1.953629; it also lost two covered finishers and two winner-in-four hits. This is a reason to verify cautiously, not confirmation.

eligibility.sealed_holdouts: All 30 remain inventory-only, unopened and unused; this protocol does not authorize their release.

capture: On every submitted eligible future card, register all races before first scheduled off, including exclusions; freeze all eligible field inputs and both full orders before first scheduled off. Publish freeze to independent timestamped storage before first off and verify receipt. Never replace a freeze. Subsequent scratches, surface changes or identity changes invalidate the original race for primary grading; log every exclusion. A corrected card requires a separately timestamped freeze and a new protocol, not retrospective substitution.
sampling: Consecutive eligible races from every registered future card; no selecting interesting races, changed orders or winners. Missing eligible snapshots invalidate the card for primary analysis and remain in the ledger.

endpoint.stop: First completed card at which both minima are reached; include whole card. Do not peek at comparative results or change rule/sample target midstream.
endpoint.interpretation: Initial confirmation attempt, not a powered guarantee; inconclusive results stay inconclusive.

primary_metric: Mean absolute predicted-rank error for actual first four finishers; average per-race mean over all four actual finishers; lower is better. Retain full predicted field so outsiders ahead are penalized.
primary_difference: candidate minus control; negative is improvement

uncertainty.interval: two-sided 95% percentile; descriptive uncertainty for this prospective sample

confirmation_rule: Endpoint completed with verified pre-off receipts and official final fields/results
Primary mean rank-error difference < 0 and upper 95% whole-card bootstrap bound < 0
Exact ordered top-four hits no worse
secondary_metrics: Exacta, trifecta and superfecta in order
failure_policy: Any safeguard failure means NOT_CONFIRMED. Insufficient sample, uncertain receipt, no order changes or interval including zero means NOT_CONFIRMED or INCONCLUSIVE; never claim success based on winners alone. No subgroup promotion or follow-up tuning on this sample.
